column2: Inventory of the QCSP 001 per-strain product specifications held in Google Drive folder
(exports/master_coa_table.tsv) and the three owner control sheets.
batches is how many batches the Tranches Overview carries for that cultivar.
in_register is whether any outsourced-laboratory certificate in the knowledgebase
names it. A spec with batches but no certificates is a real cultivar awaiting CoAs;
a spec with neither is catalogue-only — written ahead of production.
logo records how the document loads the Purely Plant mark. Files marked "relative"
point at ../assets/logo/PP_Leaf_T2.svg, which does not exist beside them in this
folder, so the header image is broken when the file is opened from here. The seven
marked "embedded" carry the SVG inline as a data URI and render standalone.
